why: HHAIR is an AI-specific restatement of metacognition, focusing on monitoring, cue validity, error detection, and self-evaluation rather than introducing a distinct general learning theory.

claims.verifier: The claim directly concerns metacognitive monitoring accuracy, showing that reliance on an invalid usefulness cue leads to performance overestimation.
The claim directly concerns the accuracy and calibration of learners’ metacognitive self-evaluations when using ChatGPT.
